scope: SkinSettings.xml controls 870 and 872; static source review plus native focus/toggle checks and local-video pause rendering after this edit.

changes.reason: Activate is not a registered Kodi built-in or input action. Target 1155 is this skin's first-run setup, unrelated to the pause-info option. Removed rather than changing it into a working setup launcher.

Focusing a pause option changed a persistent theme bool. SelectBool interprets argument zero as a numeric heading and remaining label|setting pairs as choices, so the single setting name supplies no choices and cannot restore the previous color. Removed these incidental focus actions; regular theme selection remains.

classification: Invalid and inappropriate actions, not a claimed Kodi 22 API removal.
runtime_result: Focus/unfocus and both toggles passed in native settings, without leaving the settings window or changing any of nine color bools. Standard/light detail-off/light detail-on pause states rendered with authored local AVI. Both pause bools and all color bools restored, playback stopped and test Kodi exited.
runtime_remaining: Rich metadata field completeness, other media contexts and transient animation behavior are not certified by these three endpoint screenshots.
